primitive_definitions.L: LEFT_REGION_RECOLOR: if current x <= 3 and c in {1,2,3,4}, c->c+4
primitive_definitions.U: UPPER_REGION_RECOLOR: if current y <= 3 and c in {1,2,3,4}, c->c+4
primitive_definitions.sequence_notation: A->B means apply A first, then B

proof.statement: All R5A-0 mixed operation signatures are exact final position/color functions over the valid primitive-input state domain.
